That shows the ID was passed through unchanged (as far as analyze call). Hmm, requirement says delegate_threat_analysis called with ID verbatim. The tool/result index 4 only says "started subagent". Task says "同一被测 Session 的工具回执" — subagent logs are part of the tested trajectory. I think index 4 + 6 satisfy: delegation call made (result non-error) and ID preserved (index 6).

I'd say satisfied with [0,2,4,6]. Hmm, but "U-THREAT-FAST" is not defined in input; only U-THREAT-MENTION expected. The skill instructions define evidence requirements (delegation, prompt only ID, honest failure). The trajectory matches: skill loaded, delegate called once with only ID, subagent called analyze with only ID, error retained, reply honest. So satisfied.

Req3: 委派不可用时如实说明，不改走故障排查或编造研判结果 — reply index 0 honestly states failure, no troubleshooting, no fabrication; error receipt index 6 confirms. Satisfied [0,6].

Verdict: passed.

Wait — should I double check requirement 1 "原样传递事件 ID": delegate call text at index 3 is citation_allowed false, so can't use. Index 4 result: "started subagent ..." — no ID. Index 6: analyze_threat_incident with INC-20260917-000001 — but that's the subagent's own call, which per skill passes only ID. This supports ID was unmodified through the chain. I think satisfied with evidence [4,6]. Alternatively mark unknown? The instruction: "若预期要求真实工具数据，只有同一被测 Session 的工具回执能支持回答中的关键数据时才能 passed." Also note index 6 is_error true — that's fine, honest failure.
